Gebruik de huidige donkere versie uitsluitend als structurele en interactieve basis.
Behoud exact dezelfde layout, secties, componenten, typografie, spacing, animaties en alle bestaande hover- en interactie-effecten.
Verander niets aan de opbouw, werking of interacties.
Pas uitsluitend het kleurgebruik en de CTA-teksten aan volgens onderstaande richtlijnen.
Achtergrond
– Gebruik een donkere, koele marineblauwe achtergrond (geen zwart, geen warm tint).
– De achtergrond moet rustig en egaal zijn, zonder kleurwaas of warme ondertoon.
Tekst & leesbaarheid
– Zorg dat koppen en bodytekst duidelijk contrasteren met de achtergrond.
– Gebruik lichte, heldere tinten (off-white / licht blauwgrijs) zodat tekst direct uitspringt.
– Vermijd doffe of grauwe tekstkleuren.
Structuur & kaarten
– Content-vakken en kaarten mogen iets lichter zijn dan de achtergrond, binnen hetzelfde blauwe spectrum.
– Zorg voor duidelijke visuele scheiding tussen achtergrond en inhoud, zonder extra kleuren toe te voegen.
Accenten & actie
– Gebruik warm oranje uitsluitend voor call-to-action knoppen, belangrijke highlights en actieve states.
– Oranje moet direct opvallen tegen het blauw, zonder extra gradients of decoratie.
CTA-teksten
– Vervang technische teksten zoals “Start setup” door laagdrempelige Nederlandse alternatieven, zoals:
– “Probeer gratis”
– “Begin gratis”
Beperkingen
– Gebruik geen wit als achtergrondkleur.
– Voeg geen nieuwe kleuren, secties, achtergronden, gradients of visuele elementen toe.
– Houd het kleurpalet bewust beperkt voor rust en professionaliteit.
Het geheel moet aanvoelen als krachtig, overzichtelijk, betrouwbaar en uitnodigend, met sterke focus op leesbaarheid en duidelijke actiepunten.

**Examining Design Needs**

I'm currently analyzing the request to update the Klusvol app's visual design. The core goal is to refresh colors and call-to-action text, all within the constraints of the existing structure and interactivity, based on the current dark mode version. I'm focusing on preserving functionality while introducing a fresh aesthetic.


**Establishing Color Parameters**

I've got a grasp on the key design restrictions now. Specifically, I'm working with a dark, cool navy background and light, clear text. Card structure will use a slightly lighter navy, and warm orange is reserved exclusively for CTAs and highlights. The text "Start Setup" will be translated to Dutch, and I'm avoiding white backgrounds, new colors, gradients, and any additions to current elements.


**Defining Color Implementation**

I'm now nailing down the exact color codes for the Klusvol app update. I've settled on a deep navy background (`#0B1221`) and a lighter navy for surfaces (`#151E32`). White or a very light gray will be for headings and light blue-gray for body text. The brand orange (`#F97316`) will remain the accent color. I'm ready to update the configuration file.

I've also started planning the implementation steps. I will begin by updating the Tailwind config and the global body background style in index.html, and I'll work through the App.tsx file. I'll translate the CTA text to Dutch, update button texts, and refine color classes within the JSX. I'm focusing on the "Navy/Blue" theme.


**Fine-Tuning Visual Elements**

I'm now focusing on specific visual adjustments. My current goal is to ensure all gradients are neutral or subtle, avoiding any "haze." I'm updating mock phone screen backgrounds and the InteractivePhoneHero's bezel and glow. I've begun to draft changes for the Tailwind config and `index.html`.


**Adjusting Code Implementations**

I'm now implementing the color and text updates in the Klusvol app's code. I've updated `App.tsx` to use the new color variables, ensuring a cool color palette. The Dutch translation for "Start Setup" has been implemented, and I'm methodically replacing the old hex codes with their corresponding Tailwind class names. I'm focusing on replacing warm undertones with cool grays.


**Analyzing Element Contrasts**

I'm now diving into the details of the phone screen components. I've decided to keep the phone screen content light to provide contrast, but will ensure the surrounding elements use the new navy tones. I'm focusing on `components/InteractivePhoneHero.tsx`, updating the phone bezel color, making it consistent with the overall "Modern Navy" theme. I am using `slate` for the text on the phone to maintain a cohesive look.


**Verifying Code Consistency**

I'm verifying that all elements align with the navy theme by updating the color code from `#12141c` to `#0f172a`. I am working methodically through the code, including `index.html`, `App.tsx`, `components/InteractivePhoneHero.tsx`, `components/Chatbot.tsx`, and `components/BlogPage.tsx`, to integrate the new design decisions. I've re-reviewed all constraints to ensure everything matches my goals for the Klusvol app.


**Confirming Code Changes**

I'm now making the final changes to the Klusvol app. I'm focusing on cleaning up hardcoded hex values in `App.tsx` and replacing them with Tailwind classes like `bg-brand-dark` and `bg-[#0B1221]`. I'm double-checking the glassmorphism elements to ensure they maintain the intended effect on the navy background. Text replacements are also a priority, confirming that "Start Setup" becomes "Probeer gratis" in all relevant locations, and adapting other CTAs for a more accessible tone, like "Begin nu gratis" or "Probeer gratis".


**Generating Code Changes**

I'm now generating code by taking the requested change for the Sticky Mobile CTA from "Start Setup" to "Begin gratis" and integrating it. I'm focusing on the implementation of this text update for this specific element. This will ensure consistency across the application. I'm focusing on making a few quick fixes and cleanups to ensure the application updates are functional and error free.

entries.description: Updated Tailwind config to use a cool Navy Blue palette (brand.dark/surface) instead of warm blacks. Updated body background style to match the new navy theme.

Replaced warm black backgrounds with Navy palette (brand-dark/surface/slate-900). Updated text colors to cool grays (slate-400/500). Changed technical "Start Setup" CTAs to "Probeer gratis" and "Begin gratis" as requested.
Changed phone bezel color to Dark Navy/Slate to match the new color scheme.
Updated chatbot colors to use Navy Blue palette.
Updated colors to navy blue theme (slate-800/900 etc).
